target: binary context state at t+1; reports no later than t; maximum age 8
feedback: target label revealed at target_time+7 = issue_time+8; delivery before new predictions at each time; predictors never receive unrevealed labels
generator: new seed families, 8 sources and 2 context Markov states. First 10 worlds per family have hidden source inversion and faster state changes at a random time 230..250, then return at 330..350. Last 10 worlds never change. Predictor code sees neither world regime flags nor change times.
budget: max four decoded independent eligible reports per prediction; all headers inspected; online source updates use only the reports actually consumed by that method, not uninspected votes; training may use all eligible lineages for all methods
weights: source/age correctness Beta(2,2) learned from training, no hidden reliability supplied. Window uses last128 resolved cases with initial pseudo-count mass32 fading out over first128 feedback cases. Exponential method decays non-prior counts by .98 per revealed case.
calibration: sigmoid fitted on separate calibration, fixed except FrozenRollingCal refits on last128 revealed forecasts every32 labels after64 labels, C=10 max_iter=100. No evaluation tuning.
drift_detector: mean squared error of last32 revealed calibrated forecasts > calibration mean Brier + .10; at least64 revealed labels between resets. Reset counts to Beta(2,2), disregard source updates from forecasts issued before reset, return .5 until32 post-reset cases have resolved.
portal: rank headers by absolute learned source-age log likelihood; stop after at least2 votes if abs cumulative logodds >= logit(.85), max4. Sequential conventional implementation must match recursive implementation.
primary: whole-deployment Brier and changed-world Brier vs FrozenGraph4; report all methods and controls, 1000 fixed-seed whole-world bootstrap draws
stopping: five families, no outcome-driven retuning; retain failures and negative results
platform: CPU because workload is small; no GPU or paid runtime needed
scope: authored simulation with hidden changes, not empirical forecasting or native SRDE; original tests preserved
